title: Alternate Reality trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1788931 (0x001b4c03), HLP file offset 453112 (0x0006e9f8), topic 266 'Alternate Reality'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Alternate Reality; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 279, caption 'Alternate Reality'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Alternate Reality and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Alternate Reality changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Exclusive Death Star starbase hull and Orbital Construction Module (documented-only).
Lives on starbases only; starbases cost 20% less (non-cumulative with Improved Starbases) (documented-only).
Population acts as natural miners and scanners; remote-mines its own planets; maximum population is set by starbase size; resources grow with Energy tech (documented-only).
Cannot build planetary installations; interstellar travel kills 3% of colonists in the fleet per year (documented-only).

unresolved: The documented resource formula uses habitability, population, Energy tech and an efficiency coefficient; its rounding is unrecovered.
Colonist growth and orbital capacity boundaries are unknown.
Scanner formula and installation restrictions need runtime confirmation.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
